objectives.description: Copy hook to extension-source, add to manifest provides.hooks
Copy helper script to extension-source, add to manifest provides.scripts
Append Bash PreToolUse matcher to both settings.json copies, preserving existing Write matcher

deviations.description: settings.json Bash PreToolUse matcher command text
deviations.reason: Plan specified 'bash .claude/hooks/guard-destructive-git.sh 2>/dev/null || echo {}', matching the convention used by other advisory (permissionDecision-JSON) hooks in this file. For an exit-code+stderr BLOCKING hook this is incorrect: bash `cmd || echo {}` always yields exit 0 for the composite command (since echo succeeds), silently discarding the hook's exit 2 block signal and its stderr corrective message. Registered as plain `bash .claude/hooks/guard-destructive-git.sh` instead, preserving both the exit code and stderr.
deviations.annotation: *(deviation: altered — registered without the `2>/dev/null || echo {}` suffix; see Phase 4 checklist note for full reasoning)*
